title: VKSU UG Admission Online Form 2026-30
fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Veer Kunwar Singh University, Ara has released the notification for the Graduation / Under Graduate/ Degree Course (B.A, B,.Com, B.Sc) For Academic Session 2026-30 for 4 year programme on the official website of the VKSU. The online application process for VKSU Ara UG Admission Online Form 2026-30 has started on 10 June 2026, and candidates can apply until 16 June 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for VKSU Ara UG Admission Online Form 2026-30, which are given below.

Veer Kunwar Singh University, Ara

VKSU UG Admission Online Form 2026-30

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 10 June 2026
  • Last Date : 16 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 16 June 2026
  • 1st Merit List Available : June 2026

Application Fee

  • All Category Candidates : Rs. 300/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.

VKSU University UG Online Form 2026 : Age Limit

  • As Per VKSU University Rule
  • Use Tool –

VKSU University UG Online Form 2026 : Course Details

  • Exam Name : VKSU UG admission session 2026-30 for 4 year programme under Choice Based Credit System (CBCS)
  • Exam Conduct : Veer Kunwar Singh University, Ara

VKSU University UG Online Form 2026 : Educational Qualification

Course Eligibility 
UG (Arts)
  • Candidates who have passed intermediate examination I.A./ I.Sc./ I.Com or +2 of Bihar School Examination Board or equivalent examination offered by other approved National / State Board.
UG (Commerce)
  • Candidates who have passed intermediate examination I.A./ I.Sc./ I.Com or +2 of Bihar School Examination Board or equivalent examination offered by other approved National / State Boards.
UG (Science)
  • Candidates who have passed intermediate examination I.Sc. or +2 Science Stream only of Bihar School Examination Board or equivalent examinations offered by other approved National / State Boards.

VKSU University UG Online Form 2026 : Document Requisites

Document  Size
Photograph Image
  • Size of file should be less than 50 KB
  • File format .jpg / jpeg only.
Signature Image
  • Size of file should be less than 20 KB
  • File format jpg / jpeg only.
Scanned Intermediate Marksheet
  • Size of file should be less than 250 KB
  • File format jpg / jpeg only.
Important Note : Other Scanned Certificate Size should be of 250 KB.

VKSU University UG Online Form 2026 : Helpline Number

  • Mobile : +9120130011, 7388269373 (Please Contact Us During Our Office Hours 10:00 AM to 05:00 PM)

VKSU UG Admission Online Form 2026-30 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://vksu.ac.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the VKSU Ara before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other  Notification Here – 
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for VKSU Ara UG Admission Online Form can read all the information related to the application is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
  • Note – छात्रो से ये अनुरोध किया जाता है की वो अपना फॉर्म भरने से पहले Official Notification (Last Date, Age Limit, Qualification) को ध्यान से जरूर पढे उसके बाद ही अपना फॉर्म भरे।

VKSU University UG Online Form 2026 : Mode of Selection

  • Selection will be based on Entrance Test.

Answer. The age of the candidates applying for this application form as per VKSU rules, see the post wise age information in the official information.

Answer. To apply for this application form, the candidate must have 12th pass read the official information completely before applying.

Answer. To apply for this application form, first of all you have to go to the Official Sarkari Result which is SarkariExam.com and apply through this recruitment page. Through Sarkari Result Official you can apply for many government jobs.
